name: SIDHARTH RAWAT
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A gritty player with a strong serve, solid baseline game, and tactical versatility, thriving on hard courts.
Career-High ATP Singles Ranking: #430 (February 17, 2020), Career-High ATP Doubles Ranking: #553 (February 17, 2020).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a Grand Slam main draw.
Notable Achievements: ITF Success: Won 1 ITF Futures singles title (2019 M15 Nonthaburi) and reached multiple finals (e.g., 2024 M25 Addis Ababa). Biggest Singles Win: Defeated World No. 248 Nick Chappell at the 2023 ITF M25 Monastir. National Titles: Reached the final of the 2011 Fenesta National Championship as a junior, kickstarting his pro journey. Davis Cup & National Representation: Yet to debut in Davis Cup but part of India’s tennis ecosystem.
Other Highlights: Overcame a six-year hiatus (2005-2011) to pursue tennis full-time after enrolling at Hansraj College (Delhi University). Balanced academics (Economics Honours) with tennis, opting for the sport after early ITF success in 2013. Reached the pre-quarterfinals of the 2023 ITF Davangere World Tennis Tour.
Sidharth’s resilience and late bloom make him a unique figure in Indian tennis, aiming for a Top 300 breakthrough. 🎾🇮🇳
